title: "Immune Classifier, Step 2: Atlas PCA and Harmony Function"

output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}

# Phase 2: Harmony Integration Framework
# Cardiac Immune Classifier

# Load required libraries
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(harmony)
  library(dplyr)
  library(yaml)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(here)
})

# Configuration
cat("Phase 2: Harmony Integration Framework\n")

# Load config
config_path <- here::here("config", "config.yaml")
config <- yaml::read_yaml(config_path)

cat("Configuration loaded\n")

# Load Processed Atlas
cat("\n[1/5] Loading processed atlas...\n")

atlas_path <- file.path(config$paths$data_dir, "processed", "atlas_processed.rds")
if (!file.exists(atlas_path)) {
  stop("Processed atlas not found. Run Phase 1 first: ", atlas_path)
}

seurat_atlas <- readRDS(atlas_path)

cat(sprintf("Loaded atlas with %s cells and %s genes\n",
            format(ncol(seurat_atlas), big.mark = ","),
            format(nrow(seurat_atlas), big.mark = ",")))

# Identify Variable Features
cat("\n[2/5] Identifying variable features...\n")

# Use the existing SCT assay
DefaultAssay(seurat_atlas) <- "SCT"
cat("  Using SCT assay (already normalized)\n")

# SCT already has variable features, but let's ensure we have the right number
if (length(VariableFeatures(seurat_atlas)) == 0) {
  cat("  Finding variable features...\n")
  seurat_atlas <- FindVariableFeatures(
    seurat_atlas,
    selection.method = "vst",
    nfeatures = 3000
  )
}

n_var_features <- length(VariableFeatures(seurat_atlas))
cat(sprintf("Identified %d variable features\n", n_var_features))

# Run PCA
cat("\n[3/5] Running PCA...\n")

n_pcs <- config$harmony$n_pcs

cat(sprintf("  Computing %d principal components...\n", n_pcs))
seurat_atlas <- RunPCA(
  seurat_atlas,
  features = VariableFeatures(seurat_atlas),
  npcs = n_pcs,
  verbose = FALSE
)

cat("PCA complete\n")

# Variance explained
pct_var <- (seurat_atlas@reductions$pca@stdev)^2 / 
           sum((seurat_atlas@reductions$pca@stdev)^2) * 100

cat(sprintf("  Variance explained by PC1-10: %.1f%%\n", sum(pct_var[1:10])))
cat(sprintf("  Variance explained by PC1-30: %.1f%%\n", sum(pct_var[1:30])))
cat(sprintf("  Variance explained by PC1-%d: %.1f%%\n", n_pcs, sum(pct_var[1:n_pcs])))

# Visualize PCA
cat("\n[4/5] Generating PCA visualizations...\n")

results_dir <- file.path(config$paths$results_dir, "figures", "phase2_pca")
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Elbow plot
p_elbow <- ElbowPlot(seurat_atlas, ndims = n_pcs) +
  ggtitle("PCA Elbow Plot") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(results_dir, "pca_elbow_plot.png"),
  plot = p_elbow,
  width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300
)

cat("Saved elbow plot\n")

# PCA plot colored by cell type
p_pca <- DimPlot(
  seurat_atlas,
  reduction = "pca",
  group.by = "cell_type",
  dims = c(1, 2)
) +
  ggtitle("PCA: PC1 vs PC2 (by cell type)") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(results_dir, "pca_cell_types.png"),
  plot = p_pca,
  width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300
)

cat(sprintf("Saved visualizations to: %s\n", results_dir))

# Create Harmony Integration Function
cat("\n[5/5] Creating Harmony integration function...\n")

# Used in Phase 7 to integrate query data with the atlas
harmonize_query_with_atlas <- function(
  atlas_seurat,
  query_seurat,
  theta = 2,
  dims_use = 1:50
) {
  
  # Merge atlas and query
  atlas_seurat$dataset <- "atlas"
  query_seurat$dataset <- "query"
  
  combined <- merge(atlas_seurat, query_seurat)
  
  # Find variable features on combined data
  combined <- FindVariableFeatures(combined, nfeatures = 3000)
  
  # Scale and run PCA
  combined <- ScaleData(combined)
  combined <- RunPCA(combined, npcs = max(dims_use), verbose = FALSE)
  
  # Run Harmony
  combined <- RunHarmony(
    combined,
    group.by.vars = "dataset",
    theta = theta,
    dims.use = dims_use,
    verbose = FALSE
  )
  
  return(combined)
}

# Save the function for later use
models_dir <- file.path(config$paths$results_dir, "models")
dir.create(models_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

saveRDS(
  harmonize_query_with_atlas,
  file = file.path(models_dir, "harmonize_function.rds")
)

cat("Harmony integration function saved\n")

# Save Atlas with PCA
cat("\nSaving atlas with PCA coordinates...\n")

output_path <- file.path(config$paths$data_dir, "processed", "atlas_with_pca.rds")
saveRDS(seurat_atlas, output_path)

cat(sprintf("Saved to: %s\n", output_path))
cat(sprintf("  File size: %.2f MB\n", file.size(output_path) / 1024^2))

# Summary
cat("Phase 2 Complete: Harmony Integration Framework\n")

```
